svg.aria-label: A recorded run: one sentence becomes a seven-step workflow; the model asks a person about the one answer it is unsure of, the CTO approves the reply, and the result is saved.

text.tspan: "When a prospect sends a security questionnaire, answer each question from ou
r security docs, send the ones we are unsure about to our CTO, and have the CTO approve the reply."
